simple.prompt: He said, "I work in digital marketing." -> He said that he ___ in digital marketing.
simple.explanation: Present Simple pada direct speech bergeser (backshift) menjadi Past Simple: worked.
hints: Aturan backshift tense satu tingkat ke masa lampau.
Present Simple berubah menjadi Past Simple.

simple.prompt: She said to me, "I have sent the email." -> She ___ me that she had sent the email.
simple.explanation: Kata kerja tell/told wajib diikuti objek orang langsung (told me), sedangkan said tidak bisa langsung objek orang tanpa to.
hints: Gunakan told me, bukan said me.

simple.targetSentence: He said that he was busy yesterday.
simple.explanation: Subject + said that + subject pronoun + was busy + time.

simple.prompt: Tom said, "I am learning French." -> Tom said that he ___ French.
simple.explanation: Present Continuous (am learning) bergeser menjadi Past Continuous: was learning.
hints: Present Continuous bergeser menjadi Past Continuous.

simple.prompt: Susun reported question Yes/No dengan if.
simple.targetSentence: She asked if I was ready for the presentation.
simple.explanation: She asked + if + subject + was ready for the presentation.
hints: Urutan kembali ke pernyataan normal: I was ready.

simple.prompt: "Will you join the committee?" -> She asked me if I ___ join the committee.
simple.explanation: Modal will bergeser menjadi would dalam reported speech.
hints: Bentuk lampau dari will adalah would.

simple.prompt: Susun reported command positif dengan told me to.
simple.targetSentence: The manager told me to submit the report early.
simple.explanation: Pola reported command: told + object + to-infinitive (to submit).
hints: Mulai dengan The manager told me to.
Verb dasar adalah submit the report early.

simple.prompt: Rani said, 'I work at a publishing house.' → Reported speech: Rani said that she ___ at a publishing house.
simple.explanation: Ketika reporting verb berbentuk lampau ('said'), tense mundur satu langkah (backshift): Present Simple ('work') menjadi Past Simple ('worked').
hints: Present Simple mundur menjadi Past Simple.

simple.prompt: The receptionist ___ me that the afternoon workshop had moved to Hall C.
simple.explanation: Karena ada objek penerima informasi ('me') langsung setelah verb tanpa 'to', gunakan 'told' ('tell + someone + that...'), BUKAN 'said me'.
hints: Perhatikan objek orang 'me' tepat setelah rumpang.
'Say' tidak bisa langsung diikuti orang tanpa 'to'; gunakan 'told'.

simple.prompt: 'We will ship the remaining boxes tomorrow,' the clerk promised. → He promised they ___ ship them the next day.
simple.explanation: Dalam reported speech dengan reporting verb lampau ('promised'), modal 'will' mundur menjadi 'would'.
hints: Modal 'will' ikut mengalami backshift saat dilaporkan secara lampau.

simple.prompt: Direct: 'Do you enjoy remote work?' → Reported: She asked me ___ I enjoyed remote work.
simple.explanation: Untuk melaporkan pertanyaan Yes/No ('Do you...?'), gunakan penghubung 'if' atau 'whether' (bukan 'that'), dan hilangkan auxiliary 'do'.

dialogue: Parent
What did the dentist advise Toby to do?
Caregiver
She told him ___ sugary snacks right before bedtime.
simple.explanation: Perintah atau nasihat negatif dilaporkan dengan pola 'tell + object + not to + V1' ('told him not to eat').
hints: Rumus reported negative command: 'told + sb + not to + V1'.

simple.prompt: Direct: 'I am reviewing the blueprint now.' → Reported: Dani said he ___ reviewing the blueprint then.
simple.explanation: Present Continuous ('am reviewing') mundur menjadi Past Continuous ('was reviewing'), dan 'now' berubah menjadi 'then'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum penggunaan 'said' langsung diikuti objek orang berikut.
simple.draft: My manager said me that the quarterly budget looked balanced.
options: My manager told me that the quarterly budget looked balanced.
My manager said to me that the quarterly budget look balanced.
My manager told to me that the quarterly budget looked balanced.
simple.explanation: Hindari 'said me' dan 'told to me'; gunakan 'told me' (atau 'said to me' dengan tense backshift yang benar).
hints: 'Said + orang' tanpa 'to' tidak gramatikal; 'told + to' juga salah.

simple.prompt: Direct: 'Please print three copies.' → Reported: The supervisor asked the intern ___ three copies.
simple.explanation: Permintaan sopan dilaporkan dengan pola 'ask + someone + to + V1' ('asked the intern to print').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat reported speech dengan pergeseran penanda waktu.
simple.targetSentence: She mentioned that she would submit the invoice the following day.
simple.explanation: 'Will' bergeser menjadi 'would' dan 'tomorrow' menjadi 'the following day'.
hints: Awali dengan 'She mentioned that she would'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan pertanyaan Yes/No tanpa inversi.
simple.targetSentence: He asked if our regional office stayed open on Saturdays.
simple.explanation: Dalam reported question, urutannya kembali normal Subject + Verb ('our regional office stayed') tanpa tanda tanya.
hints: Mulai dengan 'He asked if our regional office'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perubahan keterangan waktu dan tempat.
dialogue: Reporter
The minister stated: We will inaugurate the facility tomorrow.
Anchor
The minister announced that they would inaugurate the facility ___.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam reported speech, keterangan waktu tomorrow berubah menjadi the following day atau the next day.

intermediate.prompt: In reported questions, word order returns to statement order: He asked where ___.
intermediate.explanation: Pada reported question, inversi tanya dihilangkan dan urutan kembali ke Subject + Verb: the conference room was.
hints: Tidak ada tanda tanya, urutan kembali ke Subjek + Verb.

intermediate.prompt: "Don't touch the emergency valve!" -> The engineer warned us ___ the emergency valve.
intermediate.explanation: Reported negative command/warning: verb + object + NOT TO + bare verb: warned us not to touch.
hints: Pola larangan perintah: not to + V1.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat reported speech dengan suggested.
intermediate.targetSentence: The consultant suggested taking a short break.
intermediate.explanation: Suggest diikuti oleh gerund (-ing): suggested taking a short break.
hints: Diikuti gerund taking a short break.

intermediate.prompt: She said, "I bought a new vehicle." -> She explained that she ___ a new vehicle.
intermediate.explanation: Past Simple (bought) bergeser menjadi Past Perfect: had bought.
hints: Past Simple bergeser satu tingkat lagi menjadi Past Perfect.

intermediate.prompt: Susun reported question Wh- dengan urutan normal.
intermediate.targetSentence: He asked what time the train departed.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih reporting verb yang tepat untuk janji.
dialogue: Employee
I promise I will finish the task by 5 p.m.
Narrator
The employee ___ to finish the task by 5 p.m.
intermediate.explanation: Reporting verb spesifik promised + to-infinitive merangkum janji secara presisi.

intermediate.prompt: Direct: 'Where did you park the company van?' → Reported: The guard asked me where ___ the company van.
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan langsung Past Simple ('did you park') mundur menjadi Past Perfect ('had parked'), dan susunan reported question kembali ke urutan pernyataan (Subject sebelum Verb: 'where I had parked').
hints: 1) Hilangkan inversi tanya; 2) Mundurkan Past Simple ke Past Perfect.

intermediate.prompt: Direct: 'I haven't received your email yet.' → Reported: Maya explained that she ___ our email yet.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect ('haven't received') mundur menjadi Past Perfect ('hadn't received') ketika reporting verb-nya lampau ('explained').
hints: Present Perfect mundur satu langkah ke Past Perfect.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog tentang pergeseran kata keterangan tempat & waktu ('here', 'today').
dialogue: Coordinator
How should I report Riko's text: 'I am waiting here today'?
Lead
Since you are across town tomorrow, report it as: Riko texted that he was waiting ___.
intermediate.explanation: Saat sudut pandang waktu dan tempat pembicara sudah berubah keesokan harinya di tempat lain, 'here' bergeser menjadi 'there' dan 'today' menjadi 'that day'.
hints: Ubah penunjuk kedekatan ruang dan waktu: 'here' -> 'there', 'today' -> 'that day'.

intermediate.prompt: 'I'll handle the shipping paperwork,' said Bima. Using a precise reporting verb, we write: Bima ___ to handle the shipping paperwork.
intermediate.explanation: Verb 'offer' langsung berpola 'offer + to + V1' ('offered to handle'), berbeda dari 'suggest' (yang diikuti V-ing atau that-clause, tidak bisa 'suggest to handle').

intermediate.prompt: Direct: 'You must wear protective helmets.' → Reported (reporting a past rule at that site): The foreman insisted that we ___ protective helmets.
intermediate.explanation: 'Must' bermakna keharusan sering dilaporkan dalam bentuk lampau menggunakan 'had to + V1'.
hints: Modal 'must' untuk kewajiban mundur menjadi 'had to'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum tetap memakai susunan tanya (inversi) di dalam reported question berikut.
intermediate.draft: The tourist asked the guide what time did the morning train depart.
options: The tourist asked the guide what time the morning train departed.
The tourist asked the guide what time departed the morning train.
The tourist asked the guide what time does the morning train depart yesterday.
intermediate.explanation: Reported Wh-question memakai susunan pernyataan tanpa 'did': 'what time the morning train departed' (atau 'had departed').
hints: Hilangkan auxiliary 'did' dan akhiri dengan titik.
Letakkan subjek 'the morning train' sebelum verb lampau.

intermediate.prompt: Our biology teacher reminded the class that water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk kebenaran ilmiah umum atau fakta permanen ('water boils at 100°C'), tense TIDAK wajib dimundurkan meskipun reporting verb berbentuk lampau ('reminded').
hints: Ini adalah hukum fisika universal yang selalu benar.
Fakta ilmiah permanen tidak perlu di-backshift.

options: The vendor refused to lower the minimum order quantity.
The vendor refused lowering the minimum order quantity.
The vendor refused that he would lower the quantity.
intermediate.explanation: Pola baku kata kerja pelaporan 'refuse' adalah 'refuse + to + infinitive' ('refused to lower').

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan negatif dengan reporting verb 'deny' + gerund.
intermediate.targetSentence: The contractor denied altering any safety inspection records.
intermediate.explanation: 'Deny' merupakan reporting verb yang wajib diikuti gerund ('altering') atau that-clause, bukan 'to alter'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan saran tanpa 'to' menggunakan 'suggest + V-ing'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Our logistics lead suggested booking an earlier cargo flight.
intermediate.explanation: Verb 'suggest' tidak boleh memakai 'to book'; gunakan gerund ('suggested booking').

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan backshift yang tidak perlu pada fakta ilmiah abadi (universal truth).
complex.draft: The physics lecturer explained that water had boiled at 100 degrees Celsius.
options: The physics lecturer explained that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
The physics lecturer explained that water would boil at 100 degrees Celsius.
The physics lecturer explained that water was boiling at 100 degrees Celsius.
complex.explanation: Hukum alam, fakta ilmiah abadi, atau kebenaran umum (universal truths) TIDAK mengalami backshift ke bentuk lampau; tetap dalam Present Simple: water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
hints: Fakta ilmiah abadi tidak mengalami pergeseran tense.

complex.prompt: Reporting verb dengan struktur subjunctive that ... (should) be: The committee recommended that the proposal ___ without delay.
complex.explanation: Reporting verbs seperti recommend, suggest, insist, demand diikuti klausa mandat subjunctive that + subject + bare infinitive (be approved).

complex.prompt: If the situation is still true right now: Ali said that he ___ in Berlin, and he still resides there today.
complex.explanation: Jika informasi yang dilaporkan masih berlaku dan benar saat ini, pembicara boleh mempertahankan Present Simple: Ali said that he lives in Berlin.
hints: Keadaan masih benar dan berlangsung hingga saat ini.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat reported speech dengan congratulated on.
complex.targetSentence: The board congratulated Sarah on winning the award.
complex.explanation: Reporting verb pattern: congratulate + someone + on + gerund (-ing).
hints: Mulai dengan The board congratulated Sarah on.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan struktur setelah reporting verb admit.
complex.draft: The technician admitted to make a calculation error in the report.
options: The technician admitted making a calculation error in the report.
The technician admitted that he makes a calculation error in the report.
The technician admitted to have made a calculation error in the report.
complex.explanation: Admit diikuti oleh gerund (-ing) atau klausa that: admitted making / admitted that he had made.

complex.prompt: Reporting verb accusatory: The auditor accused the contractor ___ inflating procurement invoices.
complex.explanation: Collocation preposisi: accuse someone OF doing something: accused the contractor of inflating.
hints: Accuse selalu berpasangan dengan preposisi of.

dialogue: Defense Lawyer
My client is innocent of all charges.
Journalist
Counsel maintained that his client ___ innocent throughout the legal proceedings.
complex.explanation: Backshift formal Past Perfect: had been innocent.
hints: Backshift formal dalam laporan jurnalistik hukum.

complex.prompt: Direct: 'I would help if I had a van.' → Reported: He said he ___ if he had a van.
complex.explanation: Modal lampau ('would', 'could', 'might', 'should') serta Second/Third Conditional TIDAK mengalami backshift lebih jauh dalam reported speech; 'would help' tetap 'would help'.
hints: 'Would' sudah berada pada bentuk paling mundur.
Modal 'would' dan Tipe 2/3 tetap sama saat dilaporkan.

complex.prompt: Direct: 'You'd better take a taxi.' → How is 'had better' reported formally using an accurate reporting verb?
options: She advised him to take a taxi.
She told him he has better take a taxi.
She said him he bettered to take a taxi.
complex.explanation: Ungkapan saran kuat 'had better' umumnya diparafrasekan dengan verb 'advise + object + to + V1' atau dipertahankan sebagai 'had better' (tidak pernah berubah menjadi 'has better' atau 'bettered').
hints: Parafrasekan 'had better' menjadi verb pelapor yang alami.
'Advise + objek + to + V1' tepat dan ringkas.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan struktur verb pelapor 'recommend' pada kalimat rapat direksi berikut.
complex.draft: The external auditor recommended us to revise our procurement checklist immediately.
options: The external auditor recommended that we revise our procurement checklist immediately.
The external auditor recommended us revising our procurement checklist immediately.
The external auditor suggested us to revise our procurement checklist immediately.
complex.explanation: Berbeda dengan 'advise', kata 'recommend' dan 'suggest' TIDAK bisa memakai pola 'verb + person + to V1' ('recommended us to revise' salah); gunakan 'recommended that we revise...' (mandative subjunctive) atau 'recommended revising...'.
hints: 'Recommend' dan 'suggest' terlarang memakai pola 'someone to do'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang melaporkan tuntutan hukum/kebijakan dengan Mandative Subjunctive.
dialogue: Dean
What did the ethics board mandate in its formal ruling?
Secretary
The panel insisted that every research grant ___ publicly audited before renewal.
complex.explanation: Setelah verb perintah/desakan formal ('insist', 'mandate', 'demand', 'propose') + 'that', bahasa Inggris akademik dan hukum memakai Mandative Subjunctive (bare infinitive 'be', tanpa konjugasi 'is/was').
hints: Mandative subjunctive selalu memakai bentuk dasar murni 'be'.

complex.prompt: Direct: 'Why not split the dataset by region?' → Reported cleanly with a reporting verb: The analyst ___ splitting the dataset by region.
complex.explanation: 'Propose' (seperti 'suggest') dapat langsung diikuti gerund ('proposed splitting'), sedangkan 'urge' dan 'instruct' wajib diikuti objek manusia ('urged us to split').
hints: Tidak ada objek manusia di belakang rumpang.

complex.prompt: When reporting something said two minutes ago that is STILL true right now ('I'm currently in Room 4'), the manager can naturally say: 'Maya just called to say she ___ in Room 4.'
complex.explanation: Jika situasi yang dilaporkan masih relevan dan berlaku di saat ini ('just called'), penutur sering mempertahankan Present Tense ('is') tanpa backshift.
hints: Situasinya masih berlangsung saat laporan diucapkan ('just called').
Tanpa backshift ('is') menandakan fakta masih aktif sekarang.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan reporting verb 'accuse' dan preposisinya pada kalimat berita hukum berikut.
complex.draft: The regulator accused the distributor to falsifying three export certificates.
options: The regulator accused the distributor of falsifying three export certificates.
The regulator accused the distributor for falsifying three export certificates.
The regulator accused the distributor that they falsified three export certificates.
complex.explanation: Verb pelapor 'accuse' memiliki pasangan preposisi mutlak 'of + gerund': 'accuse someone of doing something' (bukan 'to' atau 'for').

complex.prompt: 'I wish I had checked the pressure gauge,' sighed the operator. → The operator regretted ___ the pressure gauge.
complex.explanation: Untuk melaporkan penyesalan atas kejadian masa lalu dengan 'regret', gunakan gerund negatif ('regret not checking' / 'not having checked'); 'regret to + V1' khusus untuk menyampaikan kabar buruk saat ini.
hints: Menyesali kejadian lalu menggunakan 'regret + (not) V-ing / having V3'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan formal memakai mandative subjunctive setelah 'demanded that'.
complex.targetSentence: The committee demanded that the supplier submit updated lab results immediately.
complex.explanation: 'Demanded that + Subject + V1 (submit)' menggunakan bentuk dasar tanpa -s/-ed.
hints: Awali dengan 'The committee demanded that the supplier'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat laporan memakai pola 'apologize for + V-ing'.
complex.targetSentence: The courier apologized for delivering the fragile crate a day late.
